ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var d=dm5Doc(result,baseUrl);var warn=d.selectFirst('.warning-bar');if(warn)throw Error('动漫屋访问限制：'+warn.text());
var container=d.selectFirst('div#chapterlistload');if(!container)throw Error('动漫屋目录缺失，请检查网页访问状态/Cookie/IP 限制');
var groups=container.select('> ul');var titles=d.select('.detail-list-title > a.block');var all=[];
for(var i=0;i<groups.size();i++){var group=groups.get(i);var as=group.select('li > a');var tag=i<titles.size()?titles.get(i).text().split('（')[0]:'';var tmp=[];
for(var k=0;k<as.size();k++){var a=as.get(k);var t=a.selectFirst('p.title');var name=t?t.text():a.text();if(a.selectFirst('.detail-lock, .view-lock'))name='🔒 '+name;tmp.push({name:name,url:dm5Abs(a.attr('href')),tag:tag});}
// Keiyoushi gives website order; Legado requires chronological order. Reverse each reverse-chronological group.
if(d.selectFirst('div.detail-list-title a.order')==null||d.selectFirst('div.detail-list-title a.order').text()!=='正序')tmp.reverse();
for(var n=0;n<tmp.length;n++)all.push(tmp[n]);}
dm5ListToLegado(all,java);
</js>
